topic: Animal Life Cycles: Butterfly, Frog, Chicken, Human
key_concepts: Animals reproduce to preserve and perpetuate their species.
Some animals are born alive while others hatch from eggs.
A butterfly has four life stages: egg, larva/caterpillar, pupa/chrysalis, and adult.
Caterpillars eat plants and grow quickly before forming a chrysalis.
Inside the chrysalis, the caterpillar transforms into an adult butterfly.
Complete metamorphosis includes egg, larva, pupa, and adult stages, as in butterflies, bee

A frog is an amphibian whose young look different from adults.
The frog life cycle includes egg, tadpole, froglet, and adult frog.
Tadpoles live in water, have gills and a tail, and lack legs at first.
A chicken begins life as an egg, hatches as a chick, and matures into an adult chicken.
Birds have life stages that include egg, hatchling, nestling, fledgling, and adult.
